Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XL OF 1965
ORDINANCE
XL OF 1965
PAKISTAN
ARMY (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1965
An
Ordinance further to amend the Pakistan Army Act, 1952
[Gazette
of Pakistan, Extraordinary, 8th October 1965]
No. F.
24 (I)/65-Pub. The following Ordinance made by the President on
the 6th October 1965, is hereby published for general information:
Whereas
it is expedient further to amend the Pakistan Army Act, 1952 (XXXIX of 1952),
for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
And
whereas the Proclamation of Emergency issued by the President clause (1) of
Article 30 of the Constitution is in force;
And
whereas the President is satisfied that immediate legislation is necessary to
meet the emergency;
Now,
therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by clause (4) of Article 30 of
the Constitution and of all other powers enabling him in that behalf, the
President is pleased to .make and promulgate the following Ordinance:‑
1. Short title and commencement. (l)
This Ordinance may be called the Pakistan Army (Amendment) Ordinance, 1965.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

under section 23."
